name: cline-pass-switcher
description: Cline Pass 上游控制台：枚举/校验/钉住订阅模型背后的上游渠道，账号池轮询，OpenAI 兼容代理

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && cd desktop && tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && cd desktop && tauri build && cd .. && node scripts/package-portable.mjs
